# TPC-DS-OBT Q71

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT item_i_brand_id AS brand_id, item_i_brand AS brand, sold_time_t_hour, sold_time_t_minute, SUM(ext_price) AS ext_price FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN (SELECT obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_price, obt.sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, obt.item_sk AS sold_item_sk, obt.sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 11 AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel = 'web' UNION ALL SELECT obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_price, obt.sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, obt.item_sk AS sold_item_sk, obt.sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 11 AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel = 'catalog' UNION ALL SELECT obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_price, obt.sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, obt.item_sk AS sold_item_sk, obt.sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 11 AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel = 'store') AS tmp WHERE (sold_item_sk = item_i_item_sk AND item_i_manager_id = 1 AND time_sk = sold_time_t_time_sk AND (sold_time_t_meal_time = 'breakfast' OR sold_time_t_meal_time = 'dinner')) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web') GROUP BY item_i_brand, item_i_brand_id, sold_time_t_hour, sold_time_t_minute ORDER BY ext_price DESC, item_i_brand_id
```
